Re: Improve word count performance

Worked out an optimized R hashcode implementation for a string:
asciiVals <- sapply(charToRaw(key), function

{ strtoi(x, 16L) }

)
hashC <- 0
for (k in 1:length(asciiVals))

{ hashC <- (hashC*31 + asciiVals[k]) %% (2 ^ 32) }

if(hashC > .Machine$integer.max)

{ hashC <- hashC - 2 * .Machine$integer.max - 2 }

as.integer(hashC)

Seems the algorithm is consistent with Java String hashcode. It can improved the performance by 3X.
Still try to investigate C version.
